newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso drops sharply on dollar buying.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso drops sharply on dollar buying.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 3.75 pesos lower at 1,050 per dollar on a wave of dollar buying by oversold banks and large corporations, interbank dealers said.
It was the second straight session in which the peso, which closed Thursday at 1,043.50, ended sharply lower.
"There were two large banks that bought big quantities of dollars to square their positions," a dealer said.
He added there was also demand for greenbacks from the corporate sector and that with no large sales of dollars from exporters the peso took an unexpected beating.
Dealers reported 301 trades for a total of $113.1 million and said the peso hit an intraday high of 1,046.30 before settling at its low for the day at the close.
